description: List the fixed AAA checklist that godot_review applies: plain text grouped by category (api, performance, quality, structure), one line per rule with its fix (on the premium profile also its id and severity). Read it before writing code to know the rules, or to look up a rule id from a finding. It does not look at the project; to check the project against these rules, use godot_review. Read-only.
name: godot_checklist
title: AAA checklist
